authoritative_data: VtkView owns disposable scene/selection/preview state. The private desktop controller owns staged tools; one engine remains the document authority.

input_output: picked(const QStringList&,bool through) is a Qt signal carrying stable display EntityIds. setPreview(RenderPreview) is transient; applyDelta(RenderDelta) returns bool admission.
Tool UI uses private ui/desktop/src/modeling_tools.cpp and desktop.cpp; versioned preview/apply/cancel calls pass through DesktopClient and engine operations.
implemented_subset.errors_and_effects: Qt/VTK are adapter types. Failed delta admission preserves installed scene; preview/cancel/leave publish no model mutation. Apply uses the application transaction once. Stale camera/selection and destroyed client callbacks require F16/F17 proof.

additional_owners.role: Public window factory; staged controller remains private and uses DesktopClient.
